items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: He said, "I hired you the first night."

ctx.x: Pacific Coast Highway. And Rex had a combo down there, him playing trumpet, piano player and drums. And at this time, Rex didn't have any embouchure. He couldn't play a one chorus melody without muffing a note, you know, splitting a note or something. And then he'd let the piano player finish it out. And he was just there fronting and jiving. And Christmas week comes up and he tells me, he says, 'Bring your bass out and sit in with us and maybe make yourself a job and we'll give you what the kitty makes, and if…

So for the first week, Christmas week up to New Years, I'm getting kitty money. So New Years night, I told Mr. LeCoco, I said, "Well, I won't be seeing you any more." I said, "I've been here a week, and I think that's time enough for you to decide whether you're going to hire me or not." He said, "What do you mean?" He said, "I hired you the first night." And he had been giving Rex my salary all this time. He said, "Wait a minute." He called Rex. He says, "Rex," he said, "I've been giving you this man's money and…
